units.fires: detections per month, averaged over the satellites of the family active that month
units.frp: summed fire radiative power in MW, averaged the same way

notes: Vegetation fires only (type 0), after the confidence filter.
null means that satellite family was not yet in orbit that month.
A grid cell (about 11 km) counts wholly toward the district holding its centre, so small districts are rough.
Districts with empty=true have an outline but no detections kept; treat them as zero.
